run_process_data: run process_data to convert webshop demonstrations into tf examples for training, validation, and test splits
create_write_processed_info: create write_processed_info to write processed demo metadata as JSON files per split and index
create_write_processed_data: create write_processed_data to write tf.train.Example objects as TFRecord files per split and index
run_main: run main to launch a Chrome driver, process webshop demo data, and quit the driver
review_process_data: review process_data to iterate demos, render screenshots, convert actions, and write tf examples with reward filtering
